product.olivetti-p750.summary: The Micro Channel 486 server with intelligent disks connected through MI549.
product.olivetti-p750.history: In September 1991 Olivetti offered P750 (the Micro Channel 486 server with intelligent disks connected through MI549).
product.olivetti-p750.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA849 / BA858 / BA865 / BA875 · 82C452 · MCA.
product.olivetti-p750.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.06.
product.olivetti-p750.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-p750.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
